People.want: Wants to access the CCC portal successfully without timeouts
People.knowledgeLevel: Can report the exact error message but is unsure about network routing causes
People.role: Representative from HHH Agency contacting AAA Insurance helpdesk about portal access

People.want: Wants to quickly determine the cause of the access issue and guide the caller
People.knowledgeLevel: Checks server status and account status; explains typical causes of timeout errors
People.role: AAA Insurance helpdesk operator providing system support and guidance

Issue.title: Cannot access the CCC portal due to connection timeout
Issue.description: The agency representative reports that the CCC portal loads for about two minutes and then shows a 'Connection Timed Out' message.

Issue.title: Do not know whether the timeout is caused by AAA servers or the local network
Issue.description: The agency representative is unsure if the problem is an AAA server outage or an issue with their office/ISP network and asks why it is timing out.

Solution.title: Contact HHH Agency IT to check network routing for access to the CCC portal
Solution.description: Open a ticket with HHH Agency's IT support so they can investigate office network or ISP routing issues preventing the computer from reaching AAA's servers; AAA cannot resolve local network timeouts.

Solution.title: Confirm servers and account are normal to rule out an AAA-side outage
Solution.description: Verify the caller’s account is active and confirm AAA servers are fully operational; explain that 'Connection Timed Out' typically indicates a local network or ISP routing issue rather than a server outage.
